title: Real-time optical signal equalization with a silicon photonic spatially distributed reservoir computer
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 21 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01968-2

Researchers experimentally demonstrate the real-time equalization of fibre distortions using a silicon photonics chip. The team equalizes a 28-Gbps on–off keying signal and obtains bit error rates as low as 4 × 10−7.

title: Circularly polarized bulk-heterojunction memory-computing organic light-emitting diodes for a neural radiance field-based 3D display
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 21 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01966-4

Circularly polarized memory-computing organic light-emitting diodes integrate three-dimensional displays with memory and processing capabilities. Optimized devices achieve luminance of over 22,000 cd m−2, dissymmetry factor of 0.92 and energy consumption down to 1.78 pJ per spike, enabling neural radiance field greyscale three-dimensional scene reconstruction.

title: Adaptive laser-tagging optofluidic microcavity for single-molecule hydrogen detection across a nine-decade concentration span
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 21 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01955-7

Laser tagging in an optofluidic microcavity enables precise hydrogen concentration detection across a broad dynamic range. Using thermal phonon transfer and dynamic resonance tracking, this spectrometry method achieves high sensitivity, low noise and effective selectivity.

title: Beyond quantum linear optics with adaptive boson sampling
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 20 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01959-3

An adaptive boson sampling architecture is developed to achieve optical evolutions beyond the usual quantum linear optics set-ups via measurement-based feedback. A set of witnesses to certify the nonlinear-optical evolution is provided.

title: Hybrid nanophotonic trap for cold atoms using surface forces and a blue-detuned evanescent field
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 09 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01961-9

A hybrid nanophotonic trap for cold caesium atoms uses surface forces for attraction and blue-detuned light for repulsion to achieve efficient loading and enhanced storage and coherence times.

title: Piconewton-sensitive cell stethoscope using an optical microcantilever
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 09 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01964-6

An optical microcantilever sensor achieves piconewton sensitivity for dynamic force measurements in liquid environments, enabling non-invasive monitoring of cellular mechanics. The stethoscope platform captures real-time dynamics for enhanced understanding of biomechanics.

title: Electro-optic comb-empowered measurement of the dynamic frequency of a laser
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 07 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01957-5

Using integrated lithium niobate electro-optic frequency combs with slightly different repetition rates, accurate tracking of the frequency variation in a frequency-modulated laser enables stable and high-precision 3D scene ranging.

title: Tracking electrons at the space-time limit
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 03 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01932-0

Atomic-scale lightwave-driven scanning tunnelling microscopy with attosecond time resolution observes individual electrons while they are tunnelling through an energy barrier.
